visualCharacteristics.imagePattern: noimg (optional small thumbnail for press photos)
visualCharacteristics.layout: Vertical list of downloadable files, one per line: type icon + label (Word / PDF / Image ...), file name link, file size aligned right; optional square thumbnail at the start of a row when an image cell is authored

contentPattern: One row per file: cell 1 = file type label (e.g. 'Word', 'PDF', 'Image'); cell 2 = link with the file name as text plus the size text (e.g. '245 KB'). Optional extra image cell for a press-photo thumbnail. Also accepts a single cell with the link and a 'TYPE size' paragraph. Links stay absolute (cdn.continental.com, or the source article URL when the file could not be resolved)
